mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns. The current FEDFUNDS of 0.4% is below the historical median, predicting positive returns.
failure_condition: The correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward returns is not negative and significant (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 0.5% signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5% are not significantly negative (p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by >0.1pp and decrease in employment (PAYEMS) by >0.5% in the past month signals labor market deterioration, producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases > 0.1pp in 1 month AND PAYEMS decreases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods meeting the trigger condition are not significantly negative (p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong economic expansion (GDPC1 quarterly growth >2.5%) drives robust corporate earnings and investor confidence, producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods when GDPC1 growth > 2.5% are not significantly positive (p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates strengthening economic activity, increasing equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns. The current INDPRO of 104.4 is above the 2017 base of 100.
failure_condition: The correlation between INDPRO and 20-day forward returns is not positive and significant (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 1000 thousand units signals a weakening housing market, reducing consumer confidence and leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods when HOUST < 1000 are not significantly negative (p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by >0.1% and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by >0.2% in the past month signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases > 0.1% in 1 month AND CPIAUCSL increases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods meeting the trigger condition are not significantly negative (p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Weak labor market conditions (UNRATE >5.5% and PAYEMS <144000 thousand) signal potential Federal Reserve monetary easing, increasing equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods meeting the trigger condition are not significantly positive (p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
